description: Prices an account's log spikes from Datadog's estimated usage metrics, with no 10x install. Reads `datadog.estimated_usage.logs.ingested_events` (datadog_is_excluded:false, by service and datadog_index) and `datadog.estimated_usage.logs.ingested_bytes` (by service) in hourly sums over `lookback` (default `90d`). An hour is a spike hour for a service when its indexed events exceed `spike_multiplier` (default 3) times the median of the same hour over the 7 days before; consecutive hours are one spike, and a service's first 7 days set its baseline. Each spike's excess events are priced at the Standard rate (list $1.70 per million, `standard_rate_per_million` overrides) and its excess bytes at ingestion (list $0.10 per GB, `ingestion_rate_per_gb` overrides). Estimates what a fleet default limit, `headroom` (default 2) times the service's largest hour outside its spikes, would have held, as an upper bound. Returns services by spike cost, each spike (start, hours, index, excess events, cost, held), the total a year at that rate, and the caveats. With `budget_usd_monthly` (X, the whole account's Standard bill a month, optionally over `standard_indexes`), also how far over X Standard went in each calendar month, the hour it crossed, and each service's share of the overage from its share of the lines past the budget. Read-only: Datadog's query API with DD_API_KEY / DD_APP_KEY / DD_SITE (GET only). Writes nothing.

budget_usd_monthly.description: X, a monthly Standard indexing budget for the whole account in dollars. Adds how far over it the account went in each month and each service's share of the overage.

headroom.description: The fleet default's multiplier on a service's largest hour outside its spikes. Default 2.

ingestion_rate_per_gb.description: The account's ingestion rate in dollars per GB. Default: list, $0.10.

limit.description: Services listed, by spike cost. Default 10.

lookback.description: Days back from now to read, e.g. `90d` (default), from `8d` to `455d`; older days the API does not return are left out. The first 7 days of each service set its baseline.

site.description: Datadog site (e.g. `us5.datadoghq.com`). Defaults to DD_SITE, then `datadoghq.com`.

spike_multiplier.description: An hour is a spike when its events exceed this many times the median of the same hour over the 7 days before. Default 3.

standard_indexes.description: With budget_usd_monthly: the index names that bill as Standard. Omit to count every index.

standard_rate_per_million.description: The account's Standard indexing rate in dollars per million events. Default: list, $1.70 (15-day retention).

view.description: `markdown` (default): the audit page. `summary`: the same data without the page.

name: log10x_datadog_spike_audit
title: Datadog spike audit
